title: LDA for Operational Risk

maps.tested: Named by the handwritten sheet alongside the EVT / block-maxima comparison.
maps.specifics: Reported: 'LDA approach'; and 'calculate z score (LDA)', which suggests a discriminant-analysis framing rather than the loss-distribution approach; these are two different things sharing an acronym and the recall is ambiguous. Cover both: loss frequency x severity convolution for operational capital, and linear discriminant analysis for scoring.

vardeezReading: ORR-4 and ORR-6: Vardeez leaves both readings untiered and says to use the crash course notes for ORR-1 to ORR-9, with no Schweser needed.

selectors.name: Frequency x severity convolution
selectors.what: The loss distribution approach: frequency (Poisson, one parameter lambda = mean = variance) and severity (lognormal or heavier-tailed) are estimated independently and convoluted into an aggregated annual loss S = X1 + ... + XN, by Monte Carlo, fast Fourier transform or Panjer recursion; E[S] = lambda x E[X] for a compound Poisson.
selectors.theory: Why loss data are split into frequency and severity (more observations, actuarial origin); the Poisson properties, including additivity, Pois(lambda_X) + Pois(lambda_Y) = Pois(lambda_X + lambda_Y); lognormal and heavier severity (Weibull, GPD); the independence and i.i.d. assumptions; the dropped-term trap of convolving only zero- and one-event years.

selectors.name: OpRisk capital: 99.9th percentile, aggregation
selectors.what: Stand-alone operational risk capital under the LDA is the 99.9th percentile of the aggregated annual loss distribution at a one-year horizon, with no expected loss subtracted; units of measure are then aggregated with explicit correlations or copulas, not by summing their percentiles.
selectors.theory: Why the 99.9% one-year standard (the AMA rule) and not 99%, and why EL is not deducted as in IRB; that adding UoM percentiles assumes perfect dependence; the UoM trade-off between homogeneity and data volume; independent Poisson UoMs with the same severity merge into one Poisson UoM; the tail completed with EVT or scenarios.

notSelected: ORR-4 a (internal, external and scenario data inputs, AMA inputs, post-2023 Standardized Approach) and ORR-6 c (asymmetry of operational loss data) carry no shape, and the discriminant-analysis reading of LDA (Altman Z-score) is tested in A10, so none of these is selected here.
